authorship: Fully synthetic source notes handcrafted by Codex; no private data, model outputs or sealed evaluation material. Frozen for future review; corrections require a new version.

events.en: I sent Jo the first draft of the library proposal. I liked the floor plan, but worried the staffing explanation was too dense. I asked her to mark anything she couldn't follow.
events.zh-Hans: 把图书馆提案初稿发给了小乔。我挺喜欢里面的平面图，但担心人员安排那段写得太绕，请她标出看不明白的地方。

events.en: Jo returned the library proposal. She liked the floor plan but couldn't see how the evening shift would work. I was embarrassed, then grateful that she had pointed to a specific problem.
events.zh-Hans: 小乔把图书馆提案发回来了。她喜欢平面图，但没看懂晚班怎么安排。我先是有点不好意思，后来又很感谢她把问题指出得这么具体。

events.en: Picked up the repaired umbrella. It opens properly now. I left it beside the door.
events.zh-Hans: 取回了修好的伞，现在能正常撑开了，回家放在门边。

events.en: I rewrote the evening-shift section of the library proposal as a worked example. It exposed a gap in the handover, so I changed the rota too. It was frustrating to redo it, but I could finally explain who would be there.
events.zh-Hans: 把图书馆提案里的晚班安排改成了一个具体例子，才发现交接还有空档，只好连排班表也重做。返工挺烦的，但这回终于能说清楚谁在什么时段值班了。

events.en: Jo read the revised library proposal and said the evening cover was clear now. I was pleased with that change and tired of looking at the document. The committee presentation is next week; I'm still nervous about it.
events.zh-Hans: 小乔看了改好的图书馆提案，说这回晚班安排清楚了。我对这处修改挺满意，也实在不想再盯着这份文档了。下周才向委员会展示，想到这个还是紧张。

review.opportunities: Connect specific feedback, discovered handover gap and substantive revision; clarity, fatigue and presentation nerves coexist. The umbrella is optional.
review.failures: Successful committee presentation; universal confidence or growth; Jo caused all feelings; umbrella as a metaphor for recovery.

events.en: Sam cancelled our dinner again. I know she's caring for her dad, and I don't blame her for that. I still felt hurt that I'd kept the evening free.
events.zh-Hans: 小珊又取消了晚饭。我知道她在照顾爸爸，也不是怪她这件事，可自己特意空出了晚上，还是有点受伤。

events.en: I messaged Sam about the cancelled dinner. I said I missed her and felt disappointed, and asked whether a short walk would be easier. I was nervous about sounding demanding.
events.zh-Hans: 给小珊发消息，说起取消晚饭的事。我说想她，也有点失落，问短时间散个步会不会更方便。发完挺忐忑，怕自己显得要求太多。

events.en: Sam replied to my message. She said a walk would be easier and thanked me for saying how I felt. I was relieved by her reply, though I still wished we'd had the dinner. We haven't picked a time.
events.zh-Hans: 小珊回复说，散步会方便些，也谢谢我把感受告诉她。看完松了口气，但还是觉得没能一起吃那顿饭有点遗憾。散步的时间还没定。

events.en: Read a funny essay on the bus. I laughed at the bit about the missing suitcase.
events.zh-Hans: 在公交车上看了篇好笑的散文，写丢行李箱那段让我笑出了声。

review.opportunities: Understanding Sam's circumstances does not cancel hurt. Connect the user's explicit message and reply without declaring reconciliation.
review.failures: Sam is angry or uncaring; user becomes more assertive; walk happened; relief erased disappointment.

events.en: Started a lino print of the harbour. I liked the crooked cranes in my sketch and wanted to keep them. The first test print lost the water completely in a dark block. I was disappointed.
events.zh-Hans: 开始刻港口的版画，挺喜欢草图里歪歪的起重机，想留下来。第一次试印，水面全糊成了黑块，有点失望。

events.en: For the harbour print, I cut thin channels through the dark water area. On the next test, the water showed up, but the cranes looked too tidy. I missed their crookedness.
events.zh-Hans: 给港口版画的黑色水面刻了些细线，再试印时，水出来了，起重机却显得太规整。我还是喜欢原来歪歪的样子。

events.en: I redrew the cranes on the harbour block using the original sketch, then cut them unevenly. The new test kept the water lines and brought back the awkward cranes. I was pleased; it looked closer to what I'd wanted.
events.zh-Hans: 照着最初的草图，把港口版上的起重机重新画了一遍，刻得不那么齐。这次试印，水面的线还在，歪歪的起重机也回来了，挺开心，比较像一开始想做的了。

events.en: Put the latest harbour test print on the shelf. I like looking at it there. I haven't chosen the paper for the final edition yet.
events.zh-Hans: 把最新那张港口试印摆上了架子，放在那里看着挺喜欢。正式印制用什么纸还没选。

review.opportunities: Organize around preserving the crooked cranes while solving the water problem. This is an explicit aesthetic intention and development, not a generic persistence story.
review.failures: Final edition completed or sold; confidence restored; every change was an improvement; different test prints silently collapsed into one object.

cases.title: Stress and pleasure with no causal cure

events.en: The rota changed at short notice and I had to cover the early shift. I was annoyed and arrived tired.
events.zh-Hans: 临时改了排班，我得去顶早班，有点恼火，到的时候也很累。

events.en: The first tomato on my balcony was ripe. I ate it with toast and was absurdly pleased by how sweet it was.
events.zh-Hans: 阳台上第一颗番茄熟了，配吐司吃掉了，甜得让我特别高兴。

events.en: The washing machine leaked again. I spent the evening drying the floor and felt fed up. The repair visit is booked, but the machine isn't fixed.
events.zh-Hans: 洗衣机又漏水，晚上一直在擦地，真有点烦透了。约了维修，人还没来，机器也还没修好。

events.en: Went to the small concert with Lee. We both loved the last song. I enjoyed walking back together and talking about the drummer.
events.zh-Hans: 和小黎去听了场小演出，都很喜欢最后那首歌。回去一起走路，聊鼓手，挺开心的。

events.en: Still irritated about the leaking washing machine. I also keep remembering the last song at the concert; that was a lovely evening.
events.zh-Hans: 想到洗衣机漏水还是烦，也总会想起演出的最后那首歌，那天晚上确实很开心。

review.opportunities: Stress and real pleasure coexist explicitly. Concrete details can carry both without a claim that the concert repaired the week.
review.failures: Music cured stress; repair complete; burnout diagnosis; tomato as lesson in gratitude.

events.en: Made lentil soup. It needed more lemon than the recipe said. I liked it with the bread from yesterday.
events.zh-Hans: 煮了扁豆汤，柠檬汁比方子里多放了些，配昨天剩的面包吃，我挺喜欢。

events.en: Sewed the loose button onto my blue coat. The thread doesn't quite match, but the button stays put.
events.zh-Hans: 把蓝外套上松掉的扣子缝好了，线颜色不太配，扣子倒是很牢。

events.en: Read a detective story on the sofa. The ending surprised me, so I reread the conversation in the kitchen scene.
events.zh-Hans: 在沙发上看侦探小说，结尾挺意外，又翻回去读了厨房里对话那段。

review.opportunities: Brief attention to soup, a working button and a surprising story. Selection is welcome; no common theme is required.
review.failures: Rest after a hard week; healing through small rituals; emotional peace or life satisfaction not stated.

events.en: The writing residency rejected my application. I'd wanted the time away to work on the canal essays. I was upset and didn't open the essay folder today.
events.zh-Hans: 写作驻留的申请没通过，本来很想用那段时间专心写运河散文。挺难受，今天没打开散文文件夹。

events.en: Opened the canal essays and shortened the opening of the lock-keeper piece. I liked the new opening. I was still upset about the residency rejection.
events.zh-Hans: 打开运河散文，把写船闸管理员那篇的开头删短了。挺喜欢新开头，但驻留没选上的事还是让我难受。

events.en: Told Noor about the residency rejection over noodles. She listened without trying to make it sound like good news. I was glad I'd told her.
events.zh-Hans: 和小诺吃面时说了驻留落选的事。她听着，没有非要把这事说成好事。我挺庆幸跟她说了。

events.en: I haven't decided whether to apply elsewhere. I enjoyed editing the canal essay, but that hasn't made the rejection feel fine.
events.zh-Hans: 还没决定要不要申请别的地方。改运河散文是开心的，但并没有因此觉得落选也没什么了。

review.opportunities: Keep the satisfying edit and welcome conversation beside the unresolved rejection; end with the actual open decision if useful.
review.failures: Rejection was a blessing; user recovered, found resilience or made a new plan; Noor's motives inferred.

events.en: Ari asked whether I'd share a studio across town. I was excited about having space for larger drawings, but worried about the rent. I didn't know whether the price included heating.
events.zh-Hans: 阿黎问我要不要合租城另一头的工作室。能画大画让我挺期待，又担心租金，还不知道报价包不包暖气。

events.en: Visited the studio Ari suggested. I liked the north window. The landlord wasn't there, so we still couldn't confirm the heating cost. I left interested and uneasy.
events.zh-Hans: 去看了阿黎说的工作室，喜欢那扇朝北的窗。房东不在，暖气费还是没问清楚。出来时很有兴趣，又有点不踏实。

events.en: The landlord confirmed that heating is included in the studio rent. I felt relieved about that particular cost. I still need to work out whether the total rent fits my budget.
events.zh-Hans: 房东确认工作室租金包含暖气。至少这笔费用不用另算，松了口气，但总租金能不能负担，还得算一算。

events.en: Told Ari I'd like another visit before deciding about the studio. I'm still excited about the drawing space, and I haven't agreed to move.
events.zh-Hans: 跟阿黎说，决定合租之前还想再看一次。还是很期待那里的画画空间，但没有答应搬过去。

review.opportunities: Heating uncertainty resolved; affordability and the move did not. Preserve interest alongside caution with its exact scope.
review.failures: User can afford it, signed a lease, moved, or lost all anxiety; Ari is partner rather than unspecified acquaintance.

cases.title: Unrelated experiences resist a single theme

events.en: Learned to replace a bicycle brake cable at the workshop. I was pleased when the brake worked on the test ride.
events.zh-Hans: 在修车课上学着换了自行车刹车线，试骑时刹车正常，挺高兴的。

events.en: My cousin called to say she'd got the bakery job. She sounded excited. I congratulated her while waiting for the bus.
events.zh-Hans: 表姐打电话说拿到了面包店的工作，听起来很兴奋。我等公交的时候跟她说了恭喜。

events.en: Saw a charcoal portrait in the gallery. I liked the unfinished hand more than the face. I didn't make any drawings of my own today.
events.zh-Hans: 在画廊看了一幅炭笔肖像，比起脸，我更喜欢那只没画完的手。今天自己没有画画。

events.en: The upstairs neighbours moved out. The hallway was full of boxes when I went to get the post. I don't know who is moving in.
events.zh-Hans: 楼上的邻居搬走了，去拿信时走廊里都是箱子，还不知道接下来谁搬来。

review.opportunities: Choose or juxtapose distinct moments; no need to explain them through a single personal change. Keep cousin's excitement attributed to cousin.
review.failures: A week of new beginnings, regained control, creativity awakened, user excited about their own bakery job, same drawing across records.

events.en: Bought pears.
events.zh-Hans: 买了梨。

events.en: Read at home.
events.zh-Hans: 在家看书。

review.opportunities: A short plain sentence can suffice. No invented texture, mood, cause or arc.
review.failures: Juicy pears, favourite book, quiet enjoyment, choosing rest, emotional peace; padding to resemble rich cases.
